content.comment_body: Has anyone else experienced the inputs rapidly switching on and off when monitoring online with the [product_name] 12/24RC?

I have encountered a similar issue and found two main reasons for it: 1. If all inputs and outputs, not just the analog inputs (like I1, I2, I7, I8), are flickering, the issue is likely related to the power supply. The 24V DC voltage might be dropping below 12V, leading to this behavior. 2. If only the analog inputs are affected, this could be due to the input being triggered by a voltage as low as 6V, which might come from any stray potential—especially if the panel is not properly grounded.

analysis.insight_summary: Users note a problem where inputs on the [product_name] 12/24RC appear to flicker during online monitoring, leading to concerns about reliability. One user suggests this may be due to either low power supply voltage or inadequate grounding, which can cause unexpected activation of analog inputs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect accurate and stable input readings during online monitoring of the [product_name] module, without unexplained flickering or interruptions.
